ast.name: appendText
ast.source: Create a Personal Access Token in your Airtable account settings.
ast.target: 在 Airtable 帳戶設定中建立個人存取權杖。

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: To get an API token create a connection in Notion and give it access to pages in your workspace.
ast.target: 若要取得 API 權杖，請在 Notion 建立連線，並授予其存取工作區頁面的權限。

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: By default Notion formulas are converted to Obsidian syntax. If any Notion syntax is not supported the static values will be saved instead. Alternatively you can import all formulas as static values.
ast.target: 預設會將 Notion 公式轉換為 Obsidian 語法。如果有不支援的 Notion 語法，會改為儲存靜態值。你也可以選擇將所有公式都匯入為靜態值。

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: Download external attachments (external URLs) to local files. Notion-hosted files are always downloaded.
ast.target: 將外部附件（外部 URL）下載成本機檔案。Notion 託管的檔案一律會下載。

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: Attachments will be saved according to your vault's attachment folder settings.
ast.target: 附件會依照儲存庫的附件資料夾設定儲存。

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: Property name for page cover image in YAML frontmatter.
ast.target: YAML frontmatter 中頁面封面圖片的屬性名稱。

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: Leave as "cover" if you don't have conflicts with existing properties.
ast.target: 如果不會與現有屬性衝突，請保留為「cover」。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Load your Airtable bases and tables, then choose what to import.
ast.target: 載入 Airtable Base 與資料表，再選擇要匯入的項目。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Try to convert formulas to Obsidian syntax, or import as static values.
ast.target: 嘗試將公式轉換為 Obsidian 語法，或匯入為靜態值。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Download attachment files to local vault. If disabled or download fails, external URLs will be used.
ast.target: 將附件檔案下載到本機儲存庫。若停用或下載失敗，則使用外部 URL。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Property name to track which views a record belongs to. Each record will have a list of view names it appears in.
ast.target: 用來記錄資料所屬檢視的屬性名稱。每筆資料都會包含其出現的檢視名稱清單。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Adds an airtable-id property to records so that future imports can skip records that have already been imported.
ast.target: 在記錄中加入 airtable-id 屬性，讓日後匯入時可略過已匯入的記錄。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Format for the creation date prefix in filenames. Use YYYY, MM, DD for year, month, day. Leave blank for no prefix.
ast.target: 檔名中建立日期前綴的格式。使用 YYYY、MM、DD 表示年、月、日。留空則不加入前綴。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Don't include the first line in the text, since Apple Notes uses it as the title. It will still be used as the note name.
ast.target: 不要將第一行包含在內文中，因為 Apple Notes 會將它作為標題。它仍會用作筆記名稱。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: When Apple Notes has detected handwriting in drawings, include it as text before the drawing.
ast.target: 當 Apple Notes 在繪圖中偵測到手寫內容時，將其作為文字加入繪圖前方。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: How to handle notes that already exist in the vault.
ast.target: 如何處理儲存庫中已存在的筆記。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Capture state-of-mind, contact, and similar tokens in YAML when available.
ast.target: 可用時，將心情、聯絡人等標記擷取到 YAML 中。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: How to handle entries that already exist in the vault.
ast.target: 如何處理儲存庫中已存在的項目。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: When enabled, tags will be split on slashes (/) during import.
ast.target: 啟用後，匯入時會依斜線 (/) 分割標籤。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Links will be automatically updated. Enable this if the note identifier is used outside of linking between notes.
ast.target: 連結會自動更新。如果筆記識別碼也用於筆記之間連結以外的地方，請啟用此選項。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: If enabled, the first row of the CSV file will be treated as column headers.
ast.target: 啟用後，CSV 檔案的第一列會視為欄位標題。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: If imported, files archived in Google Keep will be tagged as archived.
ast.target: 若匯入，Google Keep 中已封存的檔案會加上 archived 標籤。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: If imported, files deleted in Google Keep will be tagged as deleted. Deleted notes will only exist in your Google export if deleted recently.
ast.target: 若匯入，Google Keep 中已刪除的檔案會加上 deleted 標籤。已刪除的筆記只有在近期刪除時才會出現在 Google 匯出檔中。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Places the parent database pages in the same folder as the nested content.
ast.target: 將父資料庫頁面放在與巢狀內容相同的資料夾中。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Separate Notion blocks with only one line break (default is 2).
ast.target: 僅用一個換行分隔 Notion 區塊（預設為 2 個）。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Click "Load" to see data you can import. If a page or database is missing, check that your Notion integration has access to it.
ast.target: 按一下「載入」以查看可匯入的資料。如果缺少頁面或資料庫，請確認你的 Notion integration 有權限存取。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Adds a notion-id property to pages so that future imports can skip pages that have already been imported.
ast.target: 在頁面加入 notion-id 屬性，讓日後匯入時可以略過已匯入的頁面。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Separate Notion blocks with only one line break instead of two. Some blocks (lists, toggles, tables) will still use double line breaks when required for proper Markdown syntax.
ast.target: 使用一個換行而不是兩個換行分隔 Notion 區塊。部分區塊（清單、摺疊、表格）在 Markdown 語法需要時仍會使用雙換行。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Property name in page frontmatter to link pages to their database .base file (default: "base")
ast.target: 頁面 frontmatter 中用來將頁面連結到資料庫 .base 檔案的屬性名稱（預設：「base」）

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Also import databases that the selected pages link to, so relations become links rather than names. This imports pages you did not select.
ast.target: 同時匯入所選頁面連結的資料庫，使關聯轉換為連結而非名稱。這會匯入你未選取的頁面。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: If enabled, notes imported previously by this plugin will be skipped.
ast.target: 啟用後，會略過先前已由此外掛匯入的筆記。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: You need to sign in to import your OneNote data.
ast.target: 你需要登入才能匯入 OneNote 資料。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: If checked, you will be automatically logged in for subsequent imports.
ast.target: 勾選後，後續匯入時會自動登入。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: If enabled, all attachments uploaded to Roam will be downloaded to your attachments folder.
ast.target: 啟用後，所有上傳到 Roam 的附件都會下載到附件資料夾。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: If enabled, notes will have the create-time and edit-time from Roam added as properties.
ast.target: 啟用後，筆記會將 Roam 的 create-time 與 edit-time 加入為屬性。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: If enabled, notes will have the full title added as a property (regardless of illegal file name characters).
ast.target: 啟用後，筆記會將完整標題加入為屬性（不受非法檔名字元影響）。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Choose whether to keep the note title in the Markdown content. The automatic option keeps titles only when special characters are lost in filename conversion.
ast.target: 選擇是否在 Markdown 內容中保留筆記標題。自動選項只會在檔名轉換造成特殊字元遺失時保留標題。
